run_qps_diff: run the QPS diff tool to compare performance between two git commits
build_qps_binaries: build the qps_json_driver and qps_worker binaries for a given git revision
run_qps_scenarios: run QPS benchmark scenarios multiple times and save results to JSON files
diff_qps_results: compute performance differences between old and new QPS benchmark results
load_qps_json: load QPS data from a JSON result file and return the qps value
